title: PicardFixedModelResidueChainComparison
statement: Let f:X→S and fi:Xi→S, i in Fin n, be flat proper locally finitely presented, and ui:Xi→X over S. Assume the structure adjunction units of f are universally isomorphisms, L is invertible, k:W→S is an immersion, w∈U⊂W with U affine and s=k(w), and L_s descends from a finite locally free module on Spec kappa(s). Supply trivializations of each ui^*L over Xi×S U. Supply a strictly perfect connective source complex K representing R(f_W)_*L_W on U, term ranks equal to every residue Betti number, and section bases e0:Gamma(K^0)≃A and e1:Gamma(K^1)≃A^m. For each i supply a strictly perfect connective target complex C_i representing R(fi_W)_*(ui^*L)_W on U with zero degree-zero differential. For p=ker(A→kappa(w)), there exist an additive equivalence alpha:kappa(p)⊗A^m≃H^1(X_s,O), an A-linear section map t:A^m→product_i Gamma(C_i^1), and an additive map gamma:kappa(p)⊗product_i Gamma(C_i^1)→product_i H^1(Xi_s,O), satisfying t(e1(d_K(e0 inverse(a))))=0 for all a and gamma(t⊗kappa(p))(z)=(ui_s^*(alpha(z)))_i. No free ambient target or joint map b is asserted. All notions are those of [def-pc-perfect-complex], [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti], [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback], [def-pc-derived-direct-image], [def-pc-module-pullback], and [def-weil-residue-field].

source.place: Tag 0BF2, proof before the joint H-one injectivity argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BF2

proof.text: Restrict the canonical derived coefficient pullback arrows to U, conjugate by the given model isomorphisms, and represent them by chain maps K to C_i using the affine perfect-map theorem. Evaluate the degree-one component and compose with e1 inverse to obtain t_i. The chain equation and zero target degree-zero differential imply t_i(e1(d_K(e0 inverse(a))))=0 for every a.

The residue dimensions of all source terms equal their Betti numbers, so the dimension formula for cohomology forces all residue differentials to vanish. Source descent, nonemptiness forced by the structure unit, and the field rank-one theorem trivialize L_s. Derived base change and affine higher-direct-image comparison, together with the immersion and affine evaluation residue-field identifications, produce alpha.

For each normalized target the residue H-one is the kernel of its outgoing degree-one differential, since its incoming differential is zero. Choose a vector-space projection onto that kernel and compare it with H-one of the structure sheaf. Use the pulled-back source fibre trivialization itself to identify the target coefficient cohomology with structure-sheaf cohomology. This makes the coefficient pullback equal to the canonical structure-module pullback; no scalar comparison or target H-zero assumption is needed. The source residue differential vanishes, so the chain-map image lies in the kernel. Naturality of canonical derived base change and affine higher-direct-image comparison gives the asserted gamma equality. Take the product of section maps. Compose each individual residue map with tensoring its coordinate projection and take their product; the individual equations yield the joint equation.

theorem picard_fixed_model_residue_chain_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {n : ℕ}
    (Xi : Fin n → Scheme.{v}) (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ i, Flat (fi i)] [∀ i, IsProper (fi i)] [∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (fi i)]
    (ui : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hui : ∀ i, ui i ≫ f = fi i)
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (hLs : ∃ (N : (Spec (S.residueField s)).Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N))
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (htrivial : ∀ i, Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) (U.ι ≫ k))).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L) ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback (fi i) (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf))
    (m : ℕ) (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K)
    (hnegative : ∀ j : ℤ, j < 0 → IsZero (K.X j))
    (hrank : ∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (K.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)
      (ULift.{v} (Fin (derivedFiberBetti W ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) j w)))))
    (e0 : (K.X 0).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] Γ(W, U))
    (e1 : (K.X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U)))
    (hE : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
    (C : Fin n → CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hC : ∀ i, IsStrictlyPerfect W U (C i))
    (hCnegative : ∀ i j, j < 0 → IsZero ((C i).X j))
    (hCzero : ∀ i, (C i).d 0 1 = 0)
    (hCi : ∀ i, Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (fi i) k)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback (fi i) k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) k)).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L)))) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (C i))) :
    let p := RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
    letI : p.IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
    ∃ (α : (p.ResidueField ⊗[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U))) ≃+
        Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)
      (t : (Fin m → Γ(W, U)) →ₗ[Γ(W, U)]
        (∀ i, ((C i).X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))))
      (γ : (p.ResidueField ⊗[Γ(W, U)]
          (∀ i, ((C i).X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))) →+
        (∀ i, Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb
          (pullback (fi i) (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)),
      (∀ a, t (e1 ((K.d 0 1).val.app
        (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (e0.symm a))) = 0) ∧
      ∀ z, γ (t.baseChange p.ResidueField z) = fun i ↦
        structureSheafCohomologyPullback
          (((Over.pullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map
            (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (fi i)) (V := Over.mk f)
              (ui i) (hui i))).left) 1 (α z)
